Q: How to use PIP to install python-docx? A:

Yes, don't use both sudo and --user. You can use either sudo or --user.

Sometimes a reinstall messes things up. So it i always better to uninstall before you install:

pip uninstall python-docx

It seems it may be defaulting to Python 2.7. So use below command.

python3 -m pip install python-docx --user

Q: SQL query returns duplicate rows when joining three tables with GROUP BY A:

order_items schema creates multiple records for orders. Therefore, using COUNT(o.order_id) will increase the aggregate.

To avoid the inflation we need to aggregate order items first

SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.name,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.total_amount), 0) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * price) AS total_amount
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name;

This produces one row per customer with the correct order count and total amount.
